title: Telemetry metrics panel with eye openness, blink rate, and FPS
description: Implement web/src/components/MetricsPanel.jsx displaying real-time telemetry cards: Eye Openness probability, Blink Rate (BPM), Pipeline Latency (ms), and Webcam FPS & Resolution.
acceptanceCriteria: Displays 4 responsive metric sub-cards: Eye Openness, Blink Rate, FPS, Inference Latency
Uses simple progress bars where metric has a meaningful range (e.g. openness %)
Shows em dashes ('—') when telemetry is unavailable instead of fabricating values (PRD FR-06)
Updates smoothly in real-time as WebSocket messages arrive without flickering

steps.details: Create web/src/components/MetricsPanel.jsx receiving telemetry object from stream hook.
Render sub-cards: Eye Openness (percentage + mini bar), Blink Rate (BPM + normal range indicator 10-20 BPM), FPS counter, and Latency (ms).
Style sub-cards with clean white cards, pale gray borders, slate typography, and consistent spacing.
Run Playwright test verifying metrics numbers appear and format correctly; take screenshot to .agent/screenshots/TASK-26-1.png.

technicalNotes: Keep number formatting clean (e.g. 1 decimal point for FPS, integer for BPM).
Card grid should collapse to 2 columns or stack on smaller screens.
